specification.title: Solid · Cap Planar — menu binding
specification.goal: Bind menu/commandline for documented Solid Tools command “Cap Planar”; reuse owning geometry service rather than reimplement its algorithm
specification.owner_rule: The named command is a GUI/command-line action only. Call the designated implementation owner; do not create a second geometry kernel or duplicate data stores.
specification.parent_scope: Solid menu phù hợp trang sức: primitives, bool, extrusion, shell, text geometry
specification.parent_exclusions: Không thêm cơ khí thuần túy Boss/Rib/Slab dạng feature chuyên biệt.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Solid · Cap Planar — menu binding” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M03: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Solid · Cap Planar — menu binding”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.
specification.execution_status: SPEC_ONLY; NOT READY TO CODE UNTIL M00 AND TASK L4 AUDIT

technical_decisions: Matrix menu item chỉ dispatch qua qymcad/src/command_catalog.rs / command bus; không tạo một kernel thao tác song song.
Dùng cùng command descriptor, typed options và selection giữa menu, command line và toolbar; kiểm tra disable state khi backend vắng mặt.
Nếu không có owner L3 xác minh được, trạng thái BLOCKED_OWNER, không coi một menu item render thành PASS.

input.purpose: Bind menu/commandline for documented Solid Tools command “Cap Planar”; reuse owning geometry service rather than reimplement its algorithm
input.selection: typed compatible object for Cap Planar

positive.setup: Invoke `Cap Planar` through both the Matrix menu and command line with the same valid selection; inspect resulting dispatch and geometry.
positive.expected: Menu and command line resolve to one stable command ID; the owner service executes `Cap Planar` exactly once, with correct document delta and undo. No local geometry kernel inside UI adapter.

negative.setup: Invoke `Cap Planar` with missing selection, invalid parameter or unavailable backend.
negative.expected: User-visible error/disabled reason, no successful no-op, no document mutation; does not pass simply because menu renders.

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.input: explicit typed selection and deterministic numerical inputs for Cap Planar
golden_test_design.positive_assertions: valid exact BRep and explicit positive volume/shape status
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: no typed selection, invalid numerical option, locked layer, missing backend owner → visible refusal, no document change, no fake success

m03_luna_execution_contract.manual_references_precision: Many references are inherited parent-L2 page ranges, not command-exact citations
invariants: OCCT BRep/Geom is truth for exact geometry; mesh/tessellation only derived
No partial document commit on failure or cancellation
Stable object and subobject identity or explicit broken-reference error
No fabricated test receipts, measured values, or manual review
m03_luna_execution_contract.agent_handoff: Read this L3 first, then precisely one L4 child. Do not start until prerequisite gates and real source available.
